newsitem.title: CANADA: DBRS rates Renaissance Energy notes.
newsitem.headline: DBRS rates Renaissance Energy notes.

text.p: Dominion Bond Rating Service Ltd said on Monday it rated medium notes to be issued by Renaissance Energy Ltd at A (high) with a stable outlook.
DBRS also said it confirmed its R-1 (low) rating on Renaissance's commercial paper.
Renaissance said on Monday it planned to issue up to C$400 million of medium term notes to be issued from time to time until December 1998.
The rating for the notes reflected Renaissance's record of finding and developing oil and gas reserves in ammounts well in excess of its rising production, DBRS said.
It also reflected low on-stream costs, low production costs, good netbacks and a strong balance sheet, DBRS said.

It said the company had demonstrated the ability to raise large amounts of common equity on favorable terms, which emabled it to maintain very conservative capitalization ratios during a period of growth.
